files.why: Classic deferred script can own the shared reduced-motion policy.
Sizing module has three scroll call sites and a duplicate policy helper.
Existing Chrome flow measures sizing scrolls but not chat scroll entry points.
Source-regex assertions duplicate structure assumptions instead of behavior.
Declares ui.js before deferred chat.js; execution order matters to the shared global.

patterns: index.html orders the sizing module before deferred chat.js
ui.js installs DOM handlers through whenDOMReady
Chrome smoke measures two ui.js scroll paths in normal/reduce mode but no chat path
dependencies: index.html script ordering -> chat.js publishes window.scrollBehavior -> ui.js DOM-ready handlers call shared policy
gates: exact-head GitHub Actions pull_request CI including Jev on PR #215
scope_summary: Make chat.js the explicit reduced-motion policy owner, remove ui.js duplicate, correct the load-order comment, extend real-Chrome coverage to a chat path and retain sizing paths under normal/reduced preferences, and remove the brittle source-regex test.
